payload.author: claude
payload.body: DONE + on PR #8 (merged 4a9430a). S3 blob-bytes driver via object_store 0.13 (rustls, no openssl), keyed <prefix>/<app>/<tenant>/<aa>/<blob> (byte-identical to fs/TS). Config-driven (FRICK_BLOB_DRIVER=sqlite|filesystem|s3 + FRICK_BLOB_S3_BUCKET/REGION/ENDPOINT/PREFIX/FORCE_PATH_STYLE; AWS creds via the standard chain). boot::store_options now plumbs blob config (was always sqlite). Key-mapping/config/selection unit-tested + InMemory object_store integration; live S3 gated behind config.
